info.title: mt5rest
info.description:
Check our ReadMe

You can check our MT5 RESTfull API simply in browser without any coding.
To connect to mt5 account please use 'Connect' endpoint.
It returns token that you need to use in further requests as 'id' parameter.
To connect you need user number, password, host and port. Use /Search endpoint to find IP addresses of your broker.
You can open demo account on any MT5 broker. Or use this demo account for first checks:
User: 62333850
Password: tecimil4

Port: 443

get.summary: Connects to an MT5 account using the specified credentials and server details.
get.description:
This method performs a full login sequence to the specified MT5 server. Upon success, a token is generated and returned,
which uniquely identifies the session. This token must be passed in subsequent API calls.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: The server name as specified in the MT5 terminal (e.g., "MetaQuotes-Demo").

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Optional. Custom token value to assign for this session. 
If not specified, a random token will be generated and returned.

parameters.name: hardwareId
parameters.description:
Optional. Unique 16-byte hardware identifier as a hexadecimal string (e.g., "E5E28B096E7F8877334B197DE7F7F54D").
If not specified, a random ID will be generated.

parameters.name: otp
parameters.description: Optional. One-time password if two-factor authentication is enabled.

parameters.name: connectTimeoutSeconds
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for connection (default is 60 seconds).

parameters.name: connectTimeoutClusterMemberSeconds
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for connection to a cluster member (default is 30 seconds).

parameters.name: downloadOrderHistory
parameters.description:
If set to `true`, all historical orders will start downloading in the background immediately after connection.
Use the `/OrderHistoryDownloaded` endpoint to check completion status.

parameters.name: reconnectOnSymbolUpdate
parameters.description: If set to `true`, enables automatic reconnection logic on symbol data updates

200.description: Token that need to use in futher requests as 'id' parameter

Access.description: Server name and adresses from servers.dat

AccessEx.description: Server name and adresses from servers.dat

synced.description:
True when the account snapshot is fully synced with the broker (live, trustworthy).
False means these figures are the last-known values served while the terminal is
(re)connecting/resyncing — they may be stale and Balance/Equity may be 0 if the account
was never synced. Callers must not size trades off an unsynced summary.

isConnected.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the terminal is currently connected.

connectTimeUTC.description: Gets or sets the UTC timestamp of the most recent successful connection to the server.

lastQuoteTimeUTC.description: Gets or sets the UTC timestamp of the last received market quote from the server.

clientIp.description: Client IP address captured from X-Forwarded-For header at connect time.

ConnectionStatus.description:
Represents the connection status of a trading terminal,
including connectivity state and key timestamps.

code.description: Returns zero in case of internal API exception, not zero - if exception reply from server

remoteIpAddress.description: Client IP as ASP.NET sees it (after forwarded-header processing, if middleware is enabled)

localIpAddress.description: Local IP the request landed on (pod IP)

headers.description: All request headers as received by the backend

executionTimeout.description: Maximum ms to wait for execution

proxyType.description: Specifies the type of proxy servers that an instance of the ProxySocket class can use.

noServerMessagesTimeout.description: Force reconnect if no quotes for some number of milliseconds.

lastServerMessageTime.description: Local time of last server message.

connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds. Throw ConnectException if not connected at this period.

lastQuoteTime.description: Last quote time, refreshing goes with using incoming quotes.

serverTime.description: Server time, refreshing goes with using incoming quotes.

MT5API.description: Main class to trade and get data

marketName.description: Gets or sets the name of the market symbol (e.g., "EURUSD-", "GBPJPY-").

count.description: Gets or sets the total number of trades for the specified market symbol.

MarketTradeCount.description:
Represents the number of trades executed for a specific market symbol
from the inception of the account.

SessionState.description: True or false for current symbol for now

maxBalanceDrawdownRaw.description: Maximum absolute drawdown based on balance, in account currency.

maxBalanceDrawdownRelative.description: Maximum relative drawdown based on balance, as a percentage.

maxEquityDrawdownRaw.description: Maximum absolute drawdown based on equity, in account currency.

maxEquityDrawdownRelative.description: Maximum relative drawdown based on equity, as a percentage.

markets.description:
Gets or sets the trade counts grouped by market symbol
from the inception of the account.

SymbolParams.description: Information about symbol and his group.

SymbolSessions.description: Quotes and trades sessions of the symbol

tickValueMq.description: Tick value like in MT5 Terminal

openTrades.description: Gets or sets the number of currently open trades.

openProfit.description: Gets or sets the total profit or loss from currently open trades.

dayProfit.description: Gets or sets the profit or loss for the current day.

weekProfit.description: Gets or sets the profit or loss for the current week.

monthProfit.description: Gets or sets the profit or loss for the current month.

totalProfit.description: Gets or sets the total cumulative profit or loss over the account's history.

TradeSummary.description: Represents a summary of trading statistics for an account.

ticket.description: Unique ticket number of the trade.

maxUnrealizedTime.description: The time when the maximum unrealized profit occurred during the trade's lifetime.

maxUnrealizedPL.description: The highest unrealized profit value achieved by the trade.

minUnrealizedTime.description: The time when the minimum unrealized profit (maximum unrealized loss) occurred during the trade's lifetime.

minUnrealizedPL.description: The lowest unrealized profit value (largest loss) recorded for the trade.

TradeUnrealizedExtrema.description:
Contains information about maximum and minimum unrealized profit or loss 
for a specific trade, calculated over its lifetime based on historical quote data.
